subject: general
question: Select the correct option to fill blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**barking**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**barking**" refers to the sound a dog makes.
 
• In the context, Jim heard his dog making a loud sound, **which is most appropriately described as barking.**
 
• The other options: "**jumping**," "**shouting**," and "**dancing**" do not make sense in the context of a dog.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Jim thought he heard his dog barking__ loudly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Jumping (कूदना)**: refers to propelling oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet.
 
• **Shouting (चिल्लाना)**: means to say something very loudly, typically as an expression of a strong emotion.
 
• **Dancing (नाचना)**: refers to moving rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.
